name: The One Gold Model
purpose: Evidence-led, mobile-first, qualification-based, California-quality rollout to established Oregon metros and later markets without scaled doorway pages.

rollout.focus: Validate and refine already published priority pages after protected experiments reach their evidence-review gates.
rollout.rule: Review indexability, canonical, forms, titles, image appropriateness, internal intent ownership and finalized GSC query/page evidence. Do not overwrite protected experiment variables.

rollout.focus: Bring established Portland and Salem metro customer experience up to the same quality bar; prioritize existing useful city pages, not new city-name swaps.
rollout.regionalCitySource: Use Oregon Portland Metro and Salem Metro records from data/cities.json; nearby cities without dedicated pages remain request-review through the appropriate hub until city-specific coverage and useful original content are verified.
rollout.rule: Keep each city's actual access, qualified pickup process, local government alternatives and correct nearby-page links distinct. Only create additional indexable pages with verified capacity and differentiated information.

rollout.focus: Apply the proven model only to real direct/approved-partner markets, using state hubs and national request intake elsewhere.
rollout.rule: Audit routing eligibility and business facts first; do not present partner-recruiting areas as established direct branches.

auditScope: Repository configuration and pages. Does not itself measure live Google rank, publish new city pages, or change service capacity.
